cited.title: Suresh Kumar Koushal v. Naz Foundation
cited.snippet: Division Bench decision upholding Section 377 IPC — subsequently overruled expressly in Navtej Singh Johar.

by.title: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
by.snippet: Five-Judge Constitution Bench expressly overruled Suresh Kumar Koushal v. Naz Foundation insofar as Section 377 criminalizes consensual acts between adults.

cited.title: Suraj Lamp & Industries v. State of Haryana
cited.snippet: Immovable property can be legally and lawfully transferred/conveyed only by a registered deed of conveyance.
